label: Worked example: diabetes with CKD stage 3
text:
Assessment: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with chronic kidney disease stage 3.
HPI: 62-year-old presents for diabetes and kidney follow-up. Denies chest pain or shortness of breath.
Plan: Continue current regimen. Recheck renal function in 3 months.

label: Gap: heart failure without a type
text:
HPI: Here for heart failure follow-up. Mild ankle swelling.
Assessment: Hypertension. Heart failure.
Plan: Continue furosemide. Echocardiogram ordered.

label: Combination: hypertension, heart failure and CKD
text:
HPI: 77-year-old with hypertension, heart failure and chronic kidney disease.
Assessment: Hypertension. Chronic diastolic heart failure. Chronic kidney disease stage 3a.
Plan: Continue current regimen. Labs in 1 month.

text: A/P: DM2, HTN, CKD 3b. Continue current meds. BMP in 3 months.
